hypothesis: CPU instruction count is primarily explained by scheduled token volume, approximate attention query-key pairs, output projection rows, and new-request initialization.

pcvs.name: scheduled_tokens
pcvs.rationale: Tracks token-wise model computation and input preparation.

pcvs.name: scheduled_requests
pcvs.rationale: Tracks per-request metadata work and vocabulary projection rows.

pcvs.expression: sum((scheduler_output.num_scheduled_tokens[r.req_id] * (2 * r.num_computed_tokens + scheduler_output.num_scheduled_tokens[r.req_id] + 1) // 2 for r in scheduler_output.scheduled_new_reqs)) + sum((scheduler_output.num_scheduled_tokens[r] * (2 * self.requests[r].num_computed_tokens + scheduler_output.num_scheduled_tokens[r] + 1) // 2 for r in scheduler_output.scheduled_cached_reqs.req_ids))
pcvs.name: attention_pairs
pcvs.rationale: Approximates causal query-key pairs from scheduled query lengths and cached entry-state context lengths.

pcvs.name: new_requests
pcvs.rationale: Captures request initialization and persistent-batch insertion costs.
